units.source_text: 我坐在屋里看了一会儿书。

en.t: I sat in my room and read for a while.

units.source_text: 家里静悄悄的，听不到一点说话声，

en.t: The house was perfectly quiet, and I could not hear a single voice,

units.source_text: 我渐渐觉得这初冬的寒冷和静寂侵袭了我的身体。

en.t: and little by little I felt the chill and stillness of early winter creeping into my body.

units.source_text: 我突然想到热闹的地方去转转，便扣上书站起来。

en.t: Suddenly I wanted to wander somewhere lively, so I closed my book and stood up.

units.source_text: 雨终于停了，天空仍然像冰凉的铅一般沉重，

en.t: The rain had finally stopped, but the sky still hung heavy like cold lead,

units.source_text: 我怕再下雨，便扛了把蛇目伞，

en.t: and fearing it might rain again, I took a janome umbrella over my shoulder,

units.source_text: 沿着炮兵工厂后面的土围墙，走下了朝东去的坡路。

en.t: and went down the eastward slope along the earthen wall behind the artillery arsenal.

units.source_text: 那时候还没有修路，坡度比现在陡得多，

en.t: In those days the road had not yet been improved, and the slope was far steeper than it is now,

units.source_text: 路面很窄，也没有现在这么直。

en.t: the roadway was narrow, and it was not as straight as it is now.

units.source_text: 而且走下坡后，南面有高楼阻挡，雨水排不出去，

en.t: Moreover, once one went down the slope, tall buildings blocked the south side and the rainwater could not drain away,

units.source_text: 路面上泥泞不堪。

en.t: so the road was a mass of mud.

units.source_text: 特别是走过细石桥，到柳町的大马路之前的那段路，就更别提了。

en.t: The stretch after crossing the narrow stone bridge and before reaching the main street of Yanagicho was especially dreadful.

units.source_text: 哪怕穿着高齿木屐或长筒靴也不能随意行走。

en.t: Even in high clogs or long boots, one could not walk there carelessly.

units.source_text: 行人都必须小心翼翼地沿着道路中央、泥浆自然流向两边的一条窄路上走。

en.t: Everyone had to pick their way carefully along a narrow strip in the middle of the road where the mud had naturally flowed off to either side.

units.source_text: 这条窄路只有一两尺宽，

en.t: This narrow path was only one or two feet wide,

units.source_text: 人们排成一队，慢慢地走过去，就如同踩在铺在马路上的一条窄带上往前走似的，

en.t: and people moved slowly along it in single file, as though stepping forward on a narrow belt laid across the road,

units.source_text: 我就是在这条窄带上突然遇到K的。

en.t: and it was on that narrow belt that I suddenly ran into K.

units.source_text: 只顾注意脚下的我，直到走了个照面，都没有发现他，

en.t: Intent only on watching my footing, I did not notice him until we were face to face,

units.source_text: 我觉得前面突然被人挡住了，偶然抬起头，才看见站在面前的K。

en.t: and when I felt someone suddenly blocking my way and happened to look up, I saw K standing before me.

units.source_text: 我问他上哪儿去了，他只是说出来随便走走，他回答的语气跟往常一样简短。

en.t: I asked him where he had been, and he merely said he had come out for a stroll, answering in his usual curt tone.

units.source_text: 我和K在这条窄带上错身而过时，看见他身后站着一个年轻的女人。

en.t: As K and I passed each other on that narrow belt, I saw a young woman standing behind him.

units.source_text: 我眼睛近视，并没有看清楚是谁，

en.t: Being nearsighted, I had not been able to make out who she was,

units.source_text: 可是让过K之后，一看那女人的脸，原来是房东家的小姐，我不禁吃了一惊。

en.t: but after I let K pass and looked at the woman's face, I saw it was the landlord's daughter, and I could not help being startled.

units.source_text: 小姐有些脸红，向我问了声好。

en.t: The young lady blushed slightly and greeted me.

units.source_text: 那时候女人的发型跟现在不同，

en.t: Women's hairstyles in those days were different from today's,

units.source_text: 还没有出现厢发，而是把头发像蛇一样盘在头上。

en.t: with no side bangs yet; instead, the hair was coiled on the head like a snake.

units.source_text: 我呆呆地盯着小姐的头发，

en.t: I stared blankly at the young lady's hair,

units.source_text: 但马上意识到得有一方让路，

en.t: but immediately realized that one of us had to give way,

units.source_text: 便果断地一只脚踩在泥里，

en.t: so I decisively stepped one foot into the mud,

units.source_text: 留出比较好走的地方，让小姐过去了。

en.t: leaving the easier place to walk so that the young lady could pass.
